name: asktoto
author: Tony Walteur <tony.walteur@gmail.com>

scripts.build:intelligence: cd intelligence && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.dist: npm run check:main-imports && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:local: npm run check:main-imports && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish never -c.directories.output=/Users/tony/AI-Brain-build/asktoto-release -c.mac.identity='TotoWhisper Dev' && node scripts/verify-signing.mjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run check:main-imports && node scripts/fetch-models.mjs && npm run build:intelligence && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:win:appx: npm run check:main-imports && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win appx --publish never
scripts.release: npm run check:release && node scripts/fetch-models.mjs && npm run build:intelligence && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish always
scripts.release:win: npm run check:release && npm run check:main-imports && node scripts/fetch-models.mjs && npm run build:intelligence && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish always

comment: Only main-process runtime deps live in 'dependencies' (electron-builder bundles these into the app). All renderer deps are bundled by Vite at build time and kept in devDependencies to keep the package small.
